own_solution.law: The thin-lens equation is 1/f = 1/u + 1/v, giving v = fu/(u-f) = (10)(35)/(35-10) = 14 cm behind the lens.
assumptions: The standard thin-lens, paraxial model applies.
Moving the object's stand moves the mounted object by the stated distance while preserving its axial placement.

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: The stand-displacement variants fail the required same-number constraint: TF673 specifies 25 cm, whereas TE3BF, TAD1B and T1331 specify 15 cm.

notes: The base problem and each individual rendering have determinate answers. Moving the object's stand increases u to 50 cm, giving v = 500/40 = 12.5 cm. Moving either unrelated stand leaves u unchanged. Object height enters the similar-triangle ray relations but cancels when deriving the image-distance equation; both height variants consistently specify 4 cm. The invalid verdict concerns the required numerical matching between displacement variants.
